expectedText: I have tried several activities in my leisure time, but my favorite hobby is volleyball. I first played it with friends last year at a small gym. I have never joined a serious competition, and I do not worry much about the score. I enjoy exercise more when everyone helps the team. A coach showed us how to pass the ball safely, and the center provided the equipment. I have also watched a match as a spectator, which gave me some ideas for practice. I would like to cycle to the gym next time, so I will wear a helmet. My goal is to improve my fitness and enjoy time with friends.
